sources.officialityEvidence: Iceland's official legal gazette publishes Regulation No. 405/2026, which took effect immediately and amends the visa regulation's annexes.

policies.title: Kiribati ordinary passports: Iceland visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Iceland's current consolidated visa regulation lists Kíribatí in Annex 9, its visa-exempt nationality schedule.
conditions: This is limited to ordinary Kiribati-passport short visitor travel; work, residence, transit-specific rules, special documents and final border admission remain outside scope.
No stay duration is inferred from this nationality listing alone.

policies.title: Kiribati ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule directly lists Kiribati as requiring no entry visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Kiribati passport holder travelling as a short visitor; the schedule defines this category as no visa required for entry.
The schedule does not give Kiribati a common stay limit, so none is inferred. Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Kiribati ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan Tourism Board's live nationality table expressly says Kiribati passport holders can obtain a visitor visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Kiribati passport holder travelling as a short visitor; the table states a 40-JOD arrival-visa fee.
Work, residence, special documents, particular border-crossing restrictions and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Kiribati ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy visitor schedule names Kiribati in its no-visa-required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Kiribati passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Passport validity, funds, onward travel and final admission remain governed by Panama's authorities.
